_comment: Categories: external = non-Froala names (other libraries, build tools, parameters, product names) accepted only where a generic identifier is checked (inline code, descriptions, camelCase keys); options/events/buttons/plugins/methods ('module.method') = accepted by that one check only; intentionallyInvalid = names skills mention only to say they are wrong (allowed in prose, an error in code). Every entry needs a real reason.
